mapper.sql: id, task_id, step_id, attempt_no, status, error_code, error_detail, started_at, finished_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_step_attempt (task_id, step_id, attempt_no, status, started_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{stepId}, #{attemptNo}, 'RUNNING', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.task_id, a.step_id, a.attempt_no, a.status, a.error_code, a.error_detail, a.started_at, a.finished_at, a.created_at FROM task_step_attempt a JOIN task_step s ON s.id = a.step_id WHERE a.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY s.seq, a.attempt_no
SELECT FROM task_step_attempt WHERE step_id = #{stepId} AND status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE task_step_attempt SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', error_code = NULL, error_detail = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE task_step_attempt SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_detail = #{errorDetail}, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE task_step_attempt SET status = 'INTERRUPTED', error_code = NULL, error_detail = NULL, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
